components.name: Primary Listen Action
components.description: The immediate featured-release action inside the poster scene. Static documentation specimen; implementation behavior lives in src/.
components.html: PLAY FUNKACAINE
components.css: .ds-primary-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 22px; background: var(--yellow, #ffd900); color: var(--ink, #151a17); font: 600 15px/1.2 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-primary-link svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-primary-link:hover { background: var(--yellow-hover, #ffea57); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffd900); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Playback Button
components.description: The square primary control for play and pause in the listening console. Static documentation specimen; implementation behavior lives in src/.
components.html: <button class="ds-play-button" type="button" aria-label="Play track"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7L8 5Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 72px; height: 72px; padding: 0; background: var(--yellow, #ffd900); color: var(--ink, #151a17); border: 0; transition: background .2s; } .ds-play-button svg { width: 27px; height: 27px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-play-button:hover { background: var(--yellow-hover, #ffea57); } .ds-play-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffd900); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Record Sleeve
components.description: A playable, individually composed release artwork block on the pale ground. Static documentation specimen; implementation behavior lives in src/.
components.css: .ds-record-sleeve { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; color: var(--ink, #151a17); background: transparent; border: 0; text-align: left; box-shadow: 12px 18px 24px #10150e25; transition: transform .25s ease-out; } .ds-record-sleeve:hover { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-1deg); } .ds-record-sleeve:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt, #1736df); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-record-art { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; color: #eeeee4; background: var(--cobalt, #1736df) url('/assets/poster-grit.webp') center / cover; } .ds-record-artist { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 7%; left: 7%; font: 500 11px/1 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-record-art strong { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 15%; left: 7%; right: 7%; font: 400 clamp(32px, 4.8vw, 72px)/.98 Anton, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-record-edge { position: absolute; z-index: 1; left: -10%; right: -10%; bottom: -9%; height: 25%; background: var(--ink, #151a17) url('/assets/dark-grit.webp') center / 500px; transform: rotate(-12deg); } .ds-record-play { position: absolute; z-index: 3; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; background: var(--yellow, #ffd900); color: var(--ink, #151a17); } .ds-record-play svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-record-character {position:absolute;width:70%;max-width:none;left:23%;top:34%;transform:rotate(13deg);filter:drop-shadow(10px 15px 7px #0005)} .ds-record-flower {position:absolute;z-index:4;left:4%;bottom:8%;width:18%;transform:rotate(-9deg);filter:drop-shadow(3px 5px 4px #0005)} .ds-record-edge {z-index:2} .ds-record-artist,.ds-record-art strong {z-index:3}

components.name: Waveform Scrubber
components.description: The visible waveform and transparent range input that control actual track seeking. Static documentation specimen; implementation behavior lives in src/.
components.css: .ds-wave-hitbox { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 72px; cursor: ew-resize; touch-action: none; } .ds-wave { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4px, rgba(230, 230, 223, .94) 4px 6px, transparent 6px 11px); clip-path: polygon(0 50%,2% 42%,4% 66%,6% 32%,8% 55%,10% 16%,12% 76%,14% 40%,16% 62%,18% 9%,20% 82%,23% 38%,26% 66%,29% 18%,32% 88%,35% 42%,38% 72%,41% 24%,44% 91%,47% 36%,50% 65%,53% 12%,56% 84%,59% 31%,62% 73%,65% 18%,68% 89%,71% 40%,74% 64%,77% 9%,80% 84%,83% 34%,86% 71%,89% 22%,92% 88%,95% 39%,98% 65%,100% 48%); } .ds-wave-shock, .ds-wave-dilation { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; clip-path: inherit; } .ds-wave-shock { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4px, rgba(255, 255, 250, .68) 4px 6px, transparent 6px 11px); opacity: .8; } .ds-wave-dilation { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4px, var(--yellow, #ffd900) 4px 6px, transparent 6px 11px); opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-4px) scaleY(1.62); mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 18% 95% at 50% 50%, #000 0 34%, transparent 100%); } .ds-wave-hitbox input { appearance: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: ew-resize; } .ds-wave-hitbox:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffd900); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Persistent Mini Player
components.description: A compact continuation of playback shown after listening begins and the full player leaves view. Static documentation specimen; implementation behavior lives in src/.
components.html: FunkacaineBouncing Concrete
components.css: .ds-mini-player { position: fixed; z-index: 30; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: min(640px, calc(100% - 40px)); margin: auto; padding: 12px 18px 12px 12px; background: var(--paper, #e6e5dc); color: var(--ink, #151a17); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #0005; } .ds-mini-progress { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--cobalt, #1736df); } .ds-mini-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0; border: 0; background: var(--cobalt, #1736df); color: var(--paper, #e6e5dc); } .ds-mini-toggle svg, .ds-mini-next svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-mini-track { min-width: 0; flex: 1; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mini-track strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; font: 600 15px/1.2 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-mini-track span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font: 400 11px/1.2 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-mini-next { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; } .ds-mini-return { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mini-toggle:focus-visible, .ds-mini-next:focus-visible, .ds-mini-return:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt, #1736df); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-mini-return svg {width:17px;height:17px;}

narrative.northStar: The character is confined, but the music keeps getting out.
narrative.overview:
Bouncing Concrete is an Experience surface built as an authored print-to-film encounter. A cobalt physical poster, fractured white wordmark, and yellow concrete face establish the identity; the poster then recedes through the original film into a dark architectural cell and a narrow listening aperture. The visual world is tactile and physical, with visible raster texture, real artwork, and the existing 3D character carrying the atmosphere.

The page opens into listening rather than a generic catalogue. The dark cell gives way to a pale concrete records and liner-note ground, then returns to a compact dark contact and footer close. Navigation, the featured play action, actual release links, booking contact, and a persistent player remain legible inside the composition.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt/yellow print identity over dark textured architecture.
Pale concrete release and liner-note ground.
Squared controls, local depth, and authored responsive stacking.

rules.name: The Three-Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the dark textured world for film, cell, and listening; use pale paper for records and liner notes; return to a compact dark ground for contact and footer. Do not flatten the page into one continuous wash.

rules.name: The Display/Instrument Rule
rules.body: Keep Anton for the world-facing titles and DM Mono for time-based playback data; use DM Sans for explanatory copy and navigation.

rules.name: The Local-Depth Rule
rules.body: Use texture, clipping, borders, and nearby shadows to establish physical separation; do not turn the page into a collection of floating rounded cards.

dos: Do preserve the cobalt poster, fractured wordmark, yellow face, original video, and 3D character as the identity materials.
Do keep the `300vh` film, its endpoint-before-closure timing, and the reduced-motion static composition.
Do keep actual SoundCloud playback, seeking, track switching, release links, and the persistent player as functional controls.
Do keep the dark → pale → dark ground change and the authored mobile composition.
donts: Don't replace the existing GLB, pose, or aperture occlusion with a CSS illustration or generic hero art.
Don't turn the waveform into a decorative trace that is disconnected from actual seeking.
Don't invent show dates, credits, genre labels, biography facts, social profiles, or other unconfirmed artist claims.
Don't move Kuala Lumpur out of the footer or add a second location claim.
Don't collapse the world into rounded-card UI or a single undifferentiated background.
